Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing faith communities to host temporary homeless encampments subject to restrictions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to homeless tent encampments; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.185C RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.185CRCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Due to concerns about maintaining freedom of religiousexpression, religious organizations shall not be restricted fromhosting temporary encampments for the homeless. A temporary encampmentmay be subject to reasonable compliance requirements related to publichealth and safety. Fines may only be levied in cases in which thereligious organization has clearly endangered the public health orsafety of the community due to the presence of the temporaryencampment. (2) Any applicable permit fees for temporary encampments may notexceed five hundred dollars. (3) Counties, cities, and towns must respond to temporaryencampment permit applications submitted on behalf of religiousorganizations within sixty days. p. 1 SHB 2244 (4) No county, city, or town shall set less than ninety days as themaximum duration for temporary encampments.
